introHtml: Vertex school work backpacks offer the durability and organization that students and professionals need, with clean panel areas ideal for custom logo imprinting. Whether you're outfitting a sales team for a trade show or providing branded gear for a school district, Vertex backpacks combine everyday functionality with professional-grade construction. Choose from multiple compartments for laptops and tablets, plus padded straps for all-day comfort.
